jobs.title: Vi søker Butikkmedarbeider, deltid til REMA 1000 EPA!
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert og aktiv deltidsjobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Hos oss handler det om mer enn å fylle hyllene. Vi leter etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen til kundene våre – noen som møter dem med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Som butikkmedarbeider får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb 
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har fylt 18 år
  • Har du erfaring fra lignende bedrifter

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - macOS Endpoint
(Senior) Manager Network Planning Train - Bau- & Jahresplanung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

 

Als Teil unseres schnell wachsenden Travel-Tech-Unternehmens arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Infrastruktur, Betrieb und kommerzieller Planung und sorgst dafür, dass unser Netzwerk auch während umfangreicher Bauphasen attraktiv, zuverlässig und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt.

 

Über die Rolle

 

  • Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Optimierung des jährlichen Fahrplankonzepts und berücksichtigst dabei die Auswirkungen geplanter Infrastrukturmaßnahmen
  • Die Auswirkungen von Bauprojekten auf das FlixTrain-Netzwerk analysierst du und leitest daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen sowie alternative Konzepte ab
  • Datengetriebene Analysen mit Excel, BI-Tools und ersten KI-Anwendungen helfen dir dabei, kommerzielle Auswirkungen auf Nachfrage, Umsatz und Kosten zu bewerten
  • Gemeinsam mit den Teams aus Commercial Planning, Operations und Betriebsplanung entwickelst du umsetzbare Lösungen für baubedingte Herausforderungen
  • Externe Stakeholder-Termine mit DB InfraGO, der Bundesnetzagentur und weiteren Partnern bereitest du vor und vertrittst dabei die Interessen von FlixTrain

Über dich 

 

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse der Verkehrsgeographie in Deutschland und interessierst dich für die Zusammenhänge zwischen Infrastruktur, Betrieb und Wirtschaftlichkeit
  • Analytisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse zeichnen dich aus
  • Erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Network Planning (Netzplanung), Kapazitätsmanagement, Transport, Infrastruktur, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld bringst du bereits mit
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombinierst du mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sind für dich selbstverständlich
  • Erfahrungen mit KOMBau, FBS, IVU, SQL, Python, BI-Tools oder KI-Anwendungen sind ein Plus aber kein muss

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

 

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

jobs.title: JavaScript-Entwickler (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir betreuen ein JavaScript-Tool, das aus modellierten Geschäftsprozessen automatisch Auswertungen erzeugt — zum Beispiel, wie viel Arbeitszeit ein Prozess kostet und wie viele Mitarbeiter dafür nötig sind.

Das Tool ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird laufend erweitert. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung.

Aufgaben

  • Neue Funktionen in JavaScript umsetzen
  • Fehler suchen und beheben
  • Berechnungslogik anpassen, wenn sich fachliche Vorgaben ändern
  • Auswertungen erweitern und verbessern
  • Abstimmung mit dem Fachbereich
  • Ergebnisse regelmäßig dem Kunden vorstellen — remote per MS Teams

Qualifikation

  • Gute JavaScript-Kenntnisse
  • Spaß daran, dich in bestehenden Code einzuarbeiten
  • Sorgfältige Arbeitsweise — die Ergebnisse fließen in echte Personalplanung ein
  • Sicheres Auftreten in Kundenterminen — du kannst deine Ergebnisse remote per Teams verständlich präsentieren, auch gegenüber Nicht-Technikern
  • Deutsch mind. C1 in Wort und Schrift (das Projekt läuft komplett auf Deutsch)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit älterem JavaScript (ohne Frameworks)
  • Erfahrung mit der ARIS REST API
  • Kenntnisse in Geschäftsprozessmodellierung

Benefits

  • Remote-First-Arbeitsweise – arbeite dort, wo du am produktivsten bist (Homeoffice oder Co-Working)
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Ergebnisse zählen, nicht die Uhr
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte – mit modernen Technologien und spannenden Kunden
  • Modernes Equipment – leistungsstark und auf deine Bedürfnisse abgestimmt

jobs.title: Ravintolan tarjoilija, 3 paikkaa, Ravintola Esmira, Lappeenranta
jobs.description:
Esmirassa asiakas on toivottu vieras. Kommunikaatio ja asiakkaan huomioiminen ovat paljon tärkeämpää kuin etiketin osaaminen. Etsimme ennen kaikkea asiakaspalvelun ammattilaisia, jotka työskentelevät hymy huulilla myös kiireen keskellä. Aikaisempi kokemus alalla katsotaan hakijan eduksi. Palvelet asiakkaita sujuvasti sekä suomen että englannin kielellä, ja taskustasi löytyy lisäksi hygieniapassi. Mikäli suomenkielesi ei ole sujuvaa, tämä työ ei valitettavasti sovi sinulle. Anniskelupassi katsotaan hakijan eduksi. Haluat omalla työpanoksellasi taata sen, että asiakkaat viihtyvät ja saavat parhaan mahdollisen ravintolakokemuksen.

Tarjoilijana työskentelet tärkeässä roolissa asiakaspalvelun keskiössä - vastaat mm. tilausten vastaanottamisesta, ruokien sekä juomien tarjoilusta sekä ruokailusalin siisteydestä. Edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa vuoroissa, työvuorot sijoittuvat vaihtelevasti aamuille, päiville, illoille ja viikonlopuille. Emme hae kesätyöntekijää, vaan pysyvää työsuhdetta ja työntekijää. Palkkauksessa noudatetaan alan työehtosopimusta. Työnantajana olemme joustava ja huomiomme yksilölliset tarpeesi.

jobs.title: Laserhitsaaja
jobs.description:
Laserhitsaaja – Turku


Etsimme asiakkaallemme laserhitsaajaa Turkuun.


Tarjolla on määräaikainen työsuhde vuoden 2026 loppuun asti, ja työsuhteella on hyvät mahdollisuudet jatkua tämän jälkeen.


Työ on alkuvaiheessa päivätyötä, mutta myöhemmin työ voi muuttua 2-vuorotyöksi.


Työtehtävät:
Työ sisältää pääasiassa laserhitsausta sekä muita monipuolisia metallialan työtehtäviä. Tehtävä tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista nykyaikaisessa metalliteollisuudessa.


Mitä toivomme sinulta?

* Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
* Kiinnostusta laserhitsaukseen ja metallialaan
* Metallialan koulutusta tai vaihtoehtoisesti käytännön kokemusta metallitöistä
* Laserhitsauskokemus katsotaan vahvaksi eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia ja kehittyä
* Tehtävä sopii erinomaisesti myös vastavalmistuneelle metallialan osaajalle.


Tarjoamme:

* Määräaikaisen työsuhteen vähintään vuoden 2026 loppuun
* Mahdollisuuden työsuhteen jatkumiseen
* Monipuoliset työtehtävät ja mahdollisuuden kehittää laserhitsausosaamista
* Palkan 12,00–13,50 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan
* Työn aloituksen nopealla aikataululla

jobs.title: Capio Ätstörningscenter söker leg läkare - Allmänspecialist
jobs.description:
Om oss

Capio Ätstörningscenter ligger i natursköna Apelviken i Varberg.

Vi bedriver intensiv ätstörningsvård med regelbundet ätande 6 ggr/dag, KBT-E terapi med individuella och gruppsamtal.

Din roll

Din roll inom allmänmedicin – Samarbetsorienterad, Stabil & Analytisk Läkare. Du ansvarar du för medicinska bedömningar, behandlingar och kontinuerlig uppföljning av patienter på vår vårdcentral. Du samverkar tätt med sjuksköterska och övriga yrkesgrupper för att säkerställa en trygg och individanpassad vård.

• Du skapar förtroende i mötet med patienter, kollegor och samarbetspartners genom ett vänligt och samarbetsorienterat arbetssätt.

• Arbetsdagen innefattar mottagningsbesök, digitalt arbete samt deltagande i gemensamma patientrunder. • Du bidrar med både stabilitet och analytisk förmåga i arbetet med att kartlägga vårdbehov, fatta medicinska beslut och prioritera insatser.

Omväxling och utveckling präglar din vardag. Du får möjlighet att medverka i lokala förbättringsarbeten och det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet på mottagningen.

Vi erbjuder dig

Vi erbjuder dig – Utveckling och balans i yrkeslivet

• En positiv arbetsmiljö där samarbete och trivsel är centrala delar • Stöd i din yrkesroll med tätt kollegialt samarbete via Capio läkarakademi.  • Regelbunden kompetensutveckling och tillgång till Capios nationella nätverk  • Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt och utveckla rutiner. • Kollektivavtal och tjänstepension • Närvarande chef • Kompetensutveckling, både internt och externt • Friskvårdsbidrag

Om dig

Kvalifikationer och personliga egenskaper – Allmänspecialist med samarbetsfokus

• Specialistutbildning i allmänmedicin  • God förmåga att samarbeta, kommunicera och bidra till ett positivt arbetsklimat • Trygg och stabil i yrkesrollen, även i perioder av hög arbetsbelastning • Analytisk läggning med lätthet att se helheten och prioritera rätt • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift • Körkort B är meriterande

Vi söker dig som ser utveckling och samarbete som naturliga delar av arbetet. Hos oss välkomnas kollegor oavsett bakgrund. Det viktiga är ditt engagemang och vilja att bidra till såväl arbetsmiljö som god och säker vård.

Anställningsvillkor Tillsvidare, tjänstgöringsgrad och tillträde efter överenskommelse. 6 mån provanställning.

Välkommen med ansökan! Starta din karriär som allmänspecialist hos oss!

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte - skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-09-13

jobs.title: Sushi Kock
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu en kock på heltid till vårt team. Vi letar efter dig som är noggrann, serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och har förmågan att hantera stressiga situationer i ett högt arbetstempo.

Som kock hos oss kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor på en av de mest eftertraktade restaurangerna i Landskrona. Om du är snabb, engagerad och har ett stort intresse för matlagning kommer du att trivas hos oss.

Vi söker dig som har minst två års erfarenhet av arbete som kock och som vill fortsätta utvecklas och växa inom yrket.

Arbetstiderna är varierande, kvällar och helger. Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning, på heltid, med tillsättning omgående.

Vi tillhandahåller arbetskläder och som anställd hos Okaasan AB kan du känna dig trygg. Alla våra anställningar omfattas av kollektivavtal, vilket innebär avtalsenliga villkor gällande semester, lön, pension, sjukfrånvaro med mera.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Kunskaper i vietnamesiska är meriterande.

We are currently looking for one full-time Chef to join our team. We are seeking someone who is detail-oriented, service-minded, responsible, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced and sometimes stressful environment.

Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

jobs.title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

jobs.title: Psychologue (H/F)
jobs.description: CDI à temps plein Le Centre Hospitalier Neuro-Psychiatrique (CHNP) est un établissement public de référence au Luxembourg, structuré autour de trois entités aux missions complémentaires :La Rehaklinik, dédiée aux activités cliniques de réhabilitation psychiatrique ;Le Pontalize, spécialisé dans la prise en charge des personnes âgées ;De Park, axé sur l'accompagnement socio-pédagogique de personnes présentant un invalidité mental. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire existant/ante composée d'une vingtaine de professionnels investis et animés par leur mission. Ce que nous offrons : Un emploi motivant dans un environnement respectueux, dynamique et stimulant ;Poste conventionné CCT-FHL ; heures hebdomadaire (équivalent temps plein) ;Rémunération sur  mois ;Prime de risques ;Formation continue ;Pécule de vacances ; jours de congés (équivalent temps plein), congé social, .Salle de sport, restauration à tarifs avantageux, . ;Possibilités de stationnement sur site et à proximité. Cette notice peut être consultée sur notre site web www.chnp.lu. Nous vous remercions de bien vouloir en prendre connaissance avant l'envoi de votre candidature.Les candidatures devront être composées d'une lettre de motivation et d'un curriculum vitae complet.Vous reconnaissez-vous dans cette annonce ? jobs.description:
Suomen Suoramainonta Oy on osoitteettoman suoramainonnan suurin yksityinen ja valtakunnallinen markkinointi- ja jakeluyritys Suomessa. Tarjoamme yli 35 vuoden kokemuksella jakelupalveluita ja markkinoinnin suunnittelua, niin paikallisesti kuin valtakunnallisesti. Olemme osa Mediakonserni Keskisuomalaista.

Jaamme kaupunkilehtiä, mainoksia ja muita painotuotteita yli 1,8 miljoonaan kotitalouteen joka viikko koko Suomen alueella noin 3500 työntekijän voimin. Lue lisää Suomen Suoramainonta Oy:stä ja sen palveluista osoitteessa ssm.fi ja jakelutyöstä osoitteessa www.jakajaksi.fi.

Etsitkö osa-aikatyötä, jossa työpäivät ovat vakituiset, mutta voit joustavasti valita työn suorittamisen ajankohdan? Tule meille jakajaksi! Jaamme lehtiä ja mainoksia kerran viikossa, keskiviikkoisin.

Työtä tehdään muutama tunti kerrallaan tai enemmänkin, jos niin haluat. Jaettava alue valitaan kotisi läheisyydestä ja jaettavat tuotteet toimitetaan suoraan kotiovellesi. Jos kodin lähellä ei ole jakelupiirejä vapaana, työtä on mahdollista tehdä myös viikoittain vaihtuvilla jakelupiireillä, niin kutsuttuna keikkajakajana. Jos olet reipas ja työssäsi tarkka, sekä pidät itsenäisestä työskentelystä, olet etsimämme henkilö. Alueen tuntemus ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus lasketaan eduksi, mutta jalkaisin ja polkupyörällä jaettavia piirejä on myös vapaana.

Jakelutyö sopii erinomaisesti opiskeluiden tai toisen työn ohella tehtäväksi sivutyöksi. Palveluksessamme työskentelee myös eläkeläisiä ja koululaisia. Työhön voi hakea jo sinä vuonna, kun täyttää 14 vuotta. Myös kevytyrittäjänä työskentely on halukkaille mahdollista.

Paljon lisätietoa työn sisällöstä, palkasta, kokemuksia jakelutyöstä ja hakulomakkeen löydät osoitteesta [www.jakajaksi.fi](https://ssm.fi/jakajaksi/). Otamme yhteyttä, mikäli meillä on tarjolla sopiva jakelupiiri.

Lähetä työhakemus osoitteessa: [jakajaksi.fi](https://ssm.fi/jakajaksi/)

Käsittelemme vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta tulevat hakemukset.

Building a sustainable tomorrow

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service.   • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth

Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?

  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day

About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

jobs.description:
Společnost EKOBAL ROŽNOV s.r.o. hledá údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů
Jsme stabilní a rostoucí výrobní společnost s dlouholetou tradicí na trhu. Zakládáme si na kvalitě našich produktů a efektivitě výrobních procesů. Přidejte se k týmu, který udržuje naše klíčové výrobní linky v chodu.
Jsi zručný mechanik s technickým myšlením a složité stroje ti nejsou cizí? Máte rád, když věci šlapou jako hodinky a umíte je rychle najít a opravit, když se něco zadrhne? Pak hledáme přesně Vás!

Co bude Vaše hlavní náplň práce?
•    Preventivní a operativní údržba a opravy poloautomatizovaných kelímkvacích strojů (mechanická, pneumatická, elektrická část). Budete mozek a ruce našich poloautomatických kelímkovacích stroje.
•    Přestavba a seřizování kelímkovacích strojů při přechodu na jiný typ a velikost kelímku. Preciznost je klíč.
•    Diagnostika a odstraňování závad kelímkovacích strojů a  periférních zařízení. Vedení evidence oprav a údržby v SW Klid
•    Zajištění plynulého chodu výroby a minimalizace prostojů. Starat se o to, aby naše stroje jely nonstop a bez poruch (servis, mazání, kontrola – prostě prevence).
•    Spolupráce s oddělením výroby, technologie a kvality. Žádné stereotypy, každý den je jiný problém k vyřešení!
•    Drobné zámečnické práce a práce s nástroji. Výběr a udržování pohotovostního skladu náhradních dílů. Úzká spolupráce s externími firmami při zajišťování speciálních dílů a dalších prací.
Co od Vás očekáváme?
•    Minimálně SŠ/SOU v oboru mechanik, provozní zámečník, elektrikář, mechatronik nebo jiném relevantním technickém oboru.
•    Praxe na obdobné pozici (údržba/seřizování výrobních nebo balicích linek) je velkou výhodou a Vaše eso v rukávu.
•    Znalost elektrotechniky, mechaniky, pneumatiky/hydrauliky.
•    Platná vyhláška 50/1978 Sb.
•    Schopnost číst technickou dokumentaci a výkresy.
•    Samostatnost, spolehlivost a ochota pracovat ve směnném provozu.
Co Vám nabízíme?
•    Stabilní zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr ve firmě s pevnou pozicí na trhu.
•    Motivační finanční ohodnocení a systém prémií dle dosažených výsledků
•    4 týdny dovolené a zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkový paušál/ příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, firemní akce).
•    Možnost profesního rozvoje a odborných školení.
•    Moderní pracovní prostředí a technické vybavení.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in operations, business management, or revenue execution â with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience building, running, or scaling a business â including sales growth, client retention, and financial performance accountability.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the courage to ask tough questions, the polish to challenge constructively, and the vision to see what's possible before it's obvious.
  • Background check is required for this role

Essential Physical Skills

  • Repetitive finger motion as used in computer use.
  • Extensive work with computer screens
  • Everyday requirements of bending, grabbing, holding, and lifting light objects
  • Work on Hunger Projects requires heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs), moving objects, pushing, and pulling, bending and kneeling
  • Up to 50% travel time

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. Together, we’ve fulfilled over 20 million deliveries (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

⚙️Technology at Bloom & Wild

Our Technology team of over 60 people sits right at the heart of our business. We build and maintain the solutions that power e-commerce, production and fulfilment, enabling our brands to delight our customers every day.

The Product Engineering team consists of five cross-functional squads who each lead their own business and architectural domain, and are supported by our Platform, Domain Engineering, Data and IT teams.

Our platform uses technologies including Ruby and Rails and Python/ React, backed by PostgreSQL, Fargate/ECS on AWS, and Cloud Run on GCP. It exposes APIs that are used by our multi-brand Angular webapp and our native iOS and Android mobile apps.  We’re also looking at developing new domain driven services & microservices where applicable.

Most of our team is based in the UK or The Netherlands and works in a flexible model, with choice in how often they travel to the office. Our squads meet in person at least once per quarter in order to maintain connections, collaborate on larger projects and have fun together.

You can read lots more about our technology stack and our culture over on our tech blog - Code & Wild


💻 What you’ll be doing

As a Platform Engineer you'll work across the whole of Technology (Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, Data Science and Warehouse Tech) helping other engineers ship better, faster, and more safely. You'll split your time roughly equally between embedded engagements inside domain squads and central platform work on the shared infrastructure.

The role of an engineer is changing. AI has removed writing code as the scarce skill; the valuable engineer is the one who picks the right problems, scopes them, and owns them through to how they behave in production. This role leans into that shift. You will work with a high degree of independence and the work isn't always handed to you as ready-made tickets, so you'll have space to identify, shape and deliver on solutions end-to-end.

This includes:

  • Embedded Engagements: Partner with domain squads, shipping code and tools to directly enhance their capability and solve real problems.

  • Paved Roads: Build shared, adoption-driven infrastructure like feature flags, canary rollouts, fast builds, and CI/CD patterns. Making the easiest path the best path.

  • AI Integration: Extend AI across the engineering lifecycle (ticket generation, config authoring, incident response, code review), operating with AI as your core working mode and creating reusable patterns.

  • Core Infrastructure: Maintain and evolve shared services: AWS, GitHub, Datadog, Cloudflare, distributing ownership across the Platform team.

  • Eliminate Toil: Automate manual processes and remove friction from the developer day-to-day.

  • Enable Ownership: Coach squads on SLOs, observability, and AI tooling, ensuring they are capable of leading their production behaviour without relying on Platform.

  • Strategic Impact: Proactively identify, scope, and deliver high-leverage problems from month six onwards.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…
  • Have day-to-day experience with AWS and Terraform, and the judgement to balance performance, cost, and reliability.
  • Our stack includes ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Have good judgement across CI/CD and observability, comfortable with safe and reliable deployment practices (we use GitHub Actions and Terraform Cloud), and comfortable using metrics, logs, and traces to understand how applications and infrastructure behave.
  • Experience and enthusiasm using AI coding tools, or a keenness to adopt this style of working.
  • Are willing to pick up app-side stacks like Ruby and Python, and are comfortable operating inside long-lived monoliths without trying to rewrite them.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of problems (even without a ticket) you're comfortable operating in ambiguity and defining the problem before the solution.
  • A curious and innovative mindset, open to feedback and coaching, and seek out opportunities for learning and development.
  • Driven to deliver high-quality results and take initiative.
  • You love to collaborate, and are at your best when working cross-functionally with other teams.
  • You're excited about problem-solving and love to take a logical and collaborative approach to finding solutions.

    •  

    It would be great if you also have...

  • Been part of rolling out production-ownership practices across a team or organisation.

  • Experience working on an e-commerce site or in a fast-growing (preferably consumer-facing) environment.

  • Experience setting patterns that other engineers adopted without being told to.

  • Experience writing services or apps that fit into distributed architectures — working with APIs, event-driven patterns, and the contracts and practices that keep distributed systems stable.

    • You can be based in the UK, the Netherlands or elsewhere. We're flexible on what this looks like and would love to discuss how you like to work!
     
    These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.

    🌟 (some of) The good stuff

    To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day.

     

    🌻 Work that works for you 

    • Flexible working : our core hours are 10-4, but outside of these hours you can start or finish your day when works best for you

    • Work Abroad for up to 45 days each year 

    • Share in our success with a choice to take equity options

    • Enhanced family leave policy and a workplace nursery scheme

    • 1 day per year to volunteer on a project that’s close to your heart

     

    🌴 Time off

    • 25 days’ holiday + your birthday and bank holidays each year

    • Flexible bank holidays - trade a bank holiday for another day that fits your beliefs, values and celebration calendar

    • Option to buy an extra 5 days’ holiday each year 

     

    🌱 Health and wellbeing

    • Health cash plan through Simplyhealth

    • Mental health support through Open Up, including access to online therapy sessions

    • Allies and champions groups

    • Mental Health First Aiders and awareness training for our managers

    • Electric car scheme

    • Cycle to work scheme

    • Our office kitchen is stocked with drinks and snacks to keep you going

    • Financial wellbeing support through Bippit

     

    🌳 Growth & Development

    • A flexible training framework for every stage of your career development through our Bloom & Learn programme

    • Mentee and mentor opportunities with our external partners, such as The Women's Association and Mentoring for Growth run by Future Founders

    • Internal & external Speaker Sessions on a variety of different inspirational topics 

     

    💐 Moments that matter

    • Social & wellbeing monthly calendar

    • Summer and End of Year events, team lunches and post-peak celebrations

    • Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions!

     

    🏡 Belonging at Bloom & Wild

    We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.  



    🫱‍🫲 Getting hired

    We’ll do everything we can to make sure your interview experience with us is a good one. It’s a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you may have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’ll be the right place for you.  

     

    - Apply below (it takes 2 minutes!)

    - Chat with Chloe, our Talent Manager - to discuss our role and learn a bit more about you and how we might match your career & development goals.

    - Interview with some of our Platform team to get into more of the detail.

    - Show us how you work through a technical challenge, which can be a live paired whiteboard session.

    - Final chat with Steve, from our Tech leadership team.

     

    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help throughout your application process, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience.

Paid media is the heart of this role, but you'll also own key parts of the user journey, including writing, building, and launching campaign landing pages using our web tools to ensure end-to-end performance. Over time, there may also be the opportunity to support organic social planning, scheduling, and reporting alongside our Content Creator.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally from an agency or fast-paced digital environment, who is ready to step into an in-house role with more ownership, more visibility, and more chance to shape what happens next.

 


What you'll do

🚀 Own our paid digital channels: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across paid search, paid social and programmatic display, helping us reach more people ready to make the switch to electric.

 

🔍 Get properly stuck into the detail: Dive into search query reports, audiences, bids, budgets and campaign performance to spot what’s working, what’s wasting spend, and where the next opportunity is.

 

🔧 Keep the digital engine humming: Work hands-on across SA360, DV360, Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, making sure campaigns are set up cleanly, tracking works, audiences flow through, and everything goes live without drama.

 

📈 Spend smartly: Help manage digital spend within agreed monthly targets, reporting regularly on pacing, CPL and performance, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause or test next.

 

🧪 Test, learn, repeat: Partner with our Content Creator and Design team to test new creative hooks, formats, audiences and messaging across paid search, paid social and programmatic.

📊 Make reporting actually useful: Turn channel data into clear, practical insight, helping the B2C squad understand what’s happening, why, and what we should do next.

🌐 Own landing page launches & web optimisations: Take end-to-end ownership when campaigns require new landing pages and other pieces of content like quizzes, drafting page copy (with support from the team), building them using our CMS/web tools, and setting them live.

🤝 Make things happen: Coordinate briefs, assets, links, tracking and launches across content, design, web and wider marketing teams so campaigns get live quickly and with as little faff as possible. You’ll also be happy jumping into wider growth priorities when the team needs it.


What you'll need

  • Strong experience of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency, media, content or high-growth in-house environment. We’re open on exact years of experience - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

  • Strong paid search experience, with the confidence to build, manage and optimise campaigns day to day, including search query analysis, bid optimisation, budget pacing and performance reporting.

  • Experience with Google Marketing Platform, especially SA360 and Campaign Manager. DV360 experience would be a big plus, particularly if you’ve worked on programmatic display campaigns.

  • Experience managing paid social campaigns, ideally in Meta Ads Manager, with a good understanding of how creative, audiences, placements and formats affect performance.

  • A proper performance mindset. You enjoy digging into the numbers, finding wasted spend, spotting growth opportunities and working out what we should do next.

  • Good tracking and reporting hygiene. You understand why UTMs, conversion tracking, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter.

You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About the Role:

Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel.

You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. You have a high ceiling, are full of ideas, analytically rigorous, and wired to see your work drive real outcomes. You are motivated to both sell and build with AI, and here you use it to produce, test, and iterate faster than a traditional team can.

What skills do I need?

  • 8-10+ years of experience in go-to-market, regional marketing, or partner marketing, with a record of owning outcomes rather than completing tasks.
  • Experience running account- and journey-based programs against a defined target account list, from campaign build to pipeline attribution.
  • Track record collaborating with BDRs, AEs, and partners on target accounts through structured programs: joint account planning, account prioritization, and coordinated outreach against a shared pipeline target.
  • Regional market fluency: adapting messaging and programs to local buying behavior, language, and market norms.
  • Analytical rigor: you understand pipeline math, read a campaign performance report, and tell signal from noise.
  • Low ego, high accountability: you would rather learn what works than be right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and carry pipeline targets for one or more regions.
  • Build and own the regional marketing plan and account segmentation across core and ABM channels.
  • Understand regional industries and target personas, then define content needs and formats and drive production and localization.
  • Build and run account-based programs against target accounts, coordinating campaigns and outreach with BDRs and AEs.
  • Run or support conferences and regional field events from planning through pipeline attribution.
  • Use AI to produce, test, and iterate on assets and campaigns at higher volume.

Key Collaborators:

  • Regional Sales leadership
  • BDRs and Account Executives
  • RevOps
  • Digital Marketing
  • AI go-to-market engineer
  • Product Marketing

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture

jobs.title: UI Designer (m/w/d) Mobile Apps - Remote - Freelance/Contract - 3 Monate (Option auf Verlängerung)
jobs.description:
Warum diese Rolle, warum jetzt 

Wir suchen keine Person, die schöne Mockups baut und dann abwartet. 

Wir suchen jemanden, der eine Mobile App anfasst und sie danach besser aussehen lässt. Klarer, konsistenter, plattform gerechter. Jemanden, der iOS von Android unterscheidet, jemanden, dessen Figma-Dateien Entwickler:innen freuen. 

Das Feedback aus unserer bisherigen Pipeline war eindeutig: Zu viele Kandidat:innen zeigten starke UX-Thinking-Skills, aber schwache UI-Execution. Deshalb haben wir den Titel bewusst geändert. Diese Rolle ist eine UI-Rolle. Wenn dein Portfolio zeigt, wie du Interfaces baust – nicht nur konzipierst – dann lies weiter. 

 

Über DrAnsay 

DrAnsay macht Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher. Wir haben 2018 mit dem ersten digitalen Gesundheitsservice angefangen und investieren in z.B. medizinisches Cannabis, Abnehmspritze und Men's Health. 

Was uns antreibt: Ownership Over Excuses, wir nehmen Verantwortung, bauen Lösungen und bringen Dinge voran, anstatt zu warten. Clarity Creates Speed, wir kommunizieren klar, dokumentieren Entscheidungen und schaffen Transparenz. Build What Matters, wir fokussieren uns auf echten Impact, nicht auf Perfektion. 

Kleines Team, kurze Wege, echte Eigenverantwortung. Kein Investment-Board. Kein Design-by-Committee. 

 

Die Rolle 

Du arbeitest direkt im Product-/Design-Team und verantwortest die UI-Execution unserer Mobile App. Keine Endlos-Workshops. Keine Konzept-Spiralen. Du bringst visuelle Qualität auf den Screen, plattformgerecht, entwicklerfreundlich, konsistent. 

Contract. 3 Monate, mit realistischer Verlängerungsoption. Remote-first, async-freundlich, klare Absprachen statt Micro-Management. 

 

Das übernimmst du 

  • UI-Design für iOS und Android: Plattformspezifisch, nicht generisch: Human Interface Guidelines und Material Design 3 sind deine Leitplanken 

  • Figma-Arbeit auf Senior-Niveau: Auto Layout, Variablen, Design Tokens, interaktive Komponenten, Dev Mode/Handoff; deine Dateien sind so gebaut, dass Entwickler:innen keine Rückfragen brauchen 

  • Component Library & Design System: Du baust Komponenten, die skalieren: States, Varianten, Tokens, sauber dokumentiert 

  • Visuelle Qualität durchsetzen: Visual Hierarchy, Typografie, Spacing, Farbsystem; du siehst, was nicht stimmt, und du weißt, warum 

  • Pixel-Perfect Delivery: Spezifikationen, Annotations, handoff-ready

  • UI Motion Basics: Transitions und Micro-Interactions; Grundverständnis da, kein Spezialist nötig 

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product & Engineering: Async-first, dokumentierte Entscheidungen, saubere Iteration


Das bringst du mit 

Must-haves: 

  • Portfolio mit mind. 2 gelaunchten nativen Apps (iOS oder Android) mit beschriebener eigener UI-Rolle

  • Figma-Mastery: Auto Layout, Variablen/Design Tokens, Component Libraries, Prototyping, Dev Mode 

  • Mobile-Plattform-Verständnis: iOS HIG und Android Material Design 3; du weißt, was plattformnative Patterns sind 

  • Visuelle Handwerkskompetenz: Visual Hierarchy, Typografie, Spacing/Grid, Farbsystem, Kontrast 

  • Sauberer Dev-Handoff

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten im Remote-Setup, async-first, strukturierte Kommunikation 

Nice-to-haves: 

  • Design-System-Governance (Versionierung, Contribution Guidelines) 

  • Accessibility auf Mobile (WCAG, iOS/Android Standards) 

  • ProtoPie oder Principle für erweiterte Prototypen 

  • Branchenhintergrund: HealthTech, D2C, FinTech 

  • Deutschkenntnisse (kein Muss, Englisch ist Arbeitssprache) 

 

Das bieten wir 

  • Remote-first: Kein Büro, keine Pflicht-Präsenz 

  • Direkter Impact: Echte App, echte Nutzer:innen, kein internes Tool-Design 

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Feedback kommt direkt, konkret, ohne Politikebene 

  • Marktübliche Vergütung: Tagessatz nach Erfahrung und Portfolio; wir kommunizieren das direkt im ersten Gespräch 

  • Faire Zusammenarbeit: Nachhaltiges Leistungsvermögen statt Burnout-Kultur; wir messen Ergebnisse, nicht Online-Zeiten 

  • Verlängerungsoption: Wenn es passt, reden wir nach Monat 2 offen darüber 

Hinweis: Das ist ein Freelance-/Contractor-Engagement. Betriebliche Benefits sind nicht Bestandteil dieses Modells. Wir sagen das lieber direkt. 

So bewirbst du dich 

Kein Motivationsschreiben. Kein 8-seitiger Lebenslauf. 

Was wir brauchen: 

  1. Dein Portfolio: Mit gelaunchten Apps und deiner konkreten Rolle 

  1. Deine Figma-Dateien (falls möglich): Wir schauen uns gern an, wie du arbeitest 

  1. LinkedIn-Profil oder kurze Selbstvorstellung (3–4 Sätze) 

Wir geben dir innerhalb von 5 Werktagen Feedback.

Tequila Market Manager - New York

Location: New Jersey

Brand: Bandero Premium Tequila

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Bandero Premium Tequila

Bandero Premium Tequila is a fast-growing premium spirits brand entering an exciting new stage of national expansion. With increasing distribution, major retail opportunities, high-profile events, and strategic partnerships, Bandero is building meaningful momentum across the United States.

The brand is expanding its presence in key markets, developing strong relationships with leading distributors and retailers, and creating memorable consumer experiences through tastings, sponsorships, hospitality programs, and brand activations.

As Bandero continues to grow its national footprint, New York represents a major opportunity for visibility, influence, and long-term sales growth. We are seeking a driven Market Manager who is excited to help build the market from the ground up, secure influential placements, and become an important part of the brandâs continued expansion.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, connected, and results-driven New York Market Manager to lead Bandero Premium Tequilaâs growth throughout the state.

This is an opportunity to join a growing brand at a pivotal stage and play a direct role in shaping Banderoâs success in one of the most important wine and spirits markets in the country.

The New York Market Manager will be responsible for increasing sales, supporting distribution teams, securing new on-premise and off-premise placements, and building lasting relationships with key accounts and industry leaders.

The ideal candidate has strong roots in the New York hospitality and beverage community, existing relationships with buyers and decision-makers, and the entrepreneurial drive to build a premium spirits brand in a competitive market.

  • Ensure Bandero is represented professionally and consistently across all customer and consumer interactions.

  • Identify opportunities for expansion throughout New York.

Qualifications

b) układaniu towaru w magazynach, ustawianiu mebli itp.
4.Opieka nad bezpieczeństwem budynku i całością sprzętu, narzędzi oraz nad urządzeniami wykorzystywanymi do wykonywania obowiązków.

6.Drobne naprawy sprzętu i wyposażenia pomieszczeń.
7.Dbałość o czystość w budynku wewnątrz i na zewnątrz.
8.Pomoc przy dekoracji pomieszczeń budynku.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA West
jobs.description:
You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About the Role:

Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel.

You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. You have a high ceiling, are full of ideas, analytically rigorous, and wired to see your work drive real outcomes. You are motivated to both sell and build with AI, and here you use it to produce, test, and iterate faster than a traditional team can.

What skills do I need?

  • 8-10+ years of experience in go-to-market, regional marketing, or partner marketing, with a record of owning outcomes rather than completing tasks.
  • Experience running account- and journey-based programs against a defined target account list, from campaign build to pipeline attribution.
  • Track record collaborating with BDRs, AEs, and partners on target accounts through structured programs: joint account planning, account prioritization, and coordinated outreach against a shared pipeline target.
  • Regional market fluency: adapting messaging and programs to local buying behavior, language, and market norms.
  • Analytical rigor: you understand pipeline math, read a campaign performance report, and tell signal from noise.
  • Low ego, high accountability: you would rather learn what works than be right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and carry pipeline targets for one or more regions.
  • Build and own the regional marketing plan and account segmentation across core and ABM channels.
  • Understand regional industries and target personas, then define content needs and formats and drive production and localization.
  • Build and run account-based programs against target accounts, coordinating campaigns and outreach with BDRs and AEs.
  • Run or support conferences and regional field events from planning through pipeline attribution.
  • Use AI to produce, test, and iterate on assets and campaigns at higher volume.

Key Collaborators:

  • Regional Sales leadership
  • BDRs and Account Executives
  • RevOps
  • Digital Marketing
  • AI go-to-market engineer
  • Product Marketing

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
  • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy

jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Role Description:

The Sales Director is responsible for building client relationships within a specified segment. Individuals who excel in this role must have the ability to prospect via email, phone, and through the partner ecosystem, develop qualified opportunities, and close business in a timely manner while staying focused on the client's requirements. The person in this position should have the ability and confidence to close deals and ensure a smooth handoff to the appropriate teams after deal closure. This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President, Sales for EMEA.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects at an exciting time for the company. Plume is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused business in a large and growing market. If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing complex sales processes and a strong track record of meeting or exceeding your sales quota, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the assigned territory with a target prospect list and regional sales plan
  • Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth
  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Plume solution within the marketplace
  • Qualify prospects, build new opportunities, and develop ongoing revenue streams
  • Arrange and conduct initial Executive and C-suite discussions and positioning meetings
  • Own and manage the full sales process through to close
  • Provide ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and identify further revenue opportunities
  • Apply a consultative solution-based sales approach, manage complex sales cycles, and demonstrate strong presentation, listening, and organizational skills

Qualifications:

  • 5–8+ years of full-cycle, consultative sales experience, ideally selling software or cloud-based solutions to the mid-market
  • Background in cloud, ICT, software, or SaaS is preferred; experience selling to ISPs is a strong plus
  • Proven success in consistently achieving or exceeding a $1M+ ARR quota
  • Strong track record of driving pipeline, maintaining high activity levels, and closing deals
  • Skilled at identifying customer needs and presenting tailored solutions
  • Proactive, independent, and highly motivated with a positive attitude
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory and occasionally across the US
  • Experience using and applying MEDDPICC or a similar sales methodology

 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Comcast, Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.
